newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy lower house to start Olivetti probe.
newsitem.headline: Italy lower house to start Olivetti probe.

text.p: The industry commission of Italy's lower house of parliament, the Chamber of Deputies, will next week begin an inquiry into the situation at crisis-hit Olivetti, commission chairman Nerio Nesi announced on Thursday.
The commission will begin the inquiry on Tuesday with a series of hearings after which it is expected to draw up a document with its conclusions.
Among those called to appear before the inquiry will be ex-chairman Carlo De Benedetti and new chairman Antonio Tesone and chief executive Francesco Caio.
The commission will also call in Olivetti shareholders including representatives from investment funds and merchant bank Mediobanca, as well as trades unions and former Olivetti managers.
